rows.description: Puts DLSS 5 neural rendering into games that never shipped it, and brings the game's own DLSS up to date - super resolution, ray reconstruction, frame generation. Scans your library, picks one of eight routes, fetches every part from its publisher at run time, then says what happened. One exe, no admin; uninstall puts the game back.
Point Claude at any game. Skills, tools and the fal MCP that let Claude Code mod almost any PC game you own: recon, reverse engineering, fal-generated art/3D/audio, in-game testing, showcase videos.
Open source re-implementation of Tomb Raider I, Tomb Raider II and Tomb Raider III, along with additional enhancements and bugfixes
